title: The House
house: A classical house about a hundred years old, renovated with light by one woman who adores Sanzo Wada's book: tall arched French windows, panelled walls, white coffered ceilings, pale stone floors, warm brass. Bright, symmetrical and generous, with one palette in each room. Her best friend, an architectural photographer, shoots every room straight on, in its best light.
ruled_out: Left out: combinations that read as a graphic rather than a room, and pairs of two loud colours with nothing soft to rest on.

rooms.name: Living room
rooms.about: The room that sets the house: pale blue panelling, a cinnamon velvet sofa, two yellow chairs, morning light through arched windows.

rooms.name: Entrance hall
rooms.about: Seen from the living room. Stone floor, a staircase, the first impression.

options.idea: Salvia blue and grey, with deep indigo on the stair: a calm blue lead-in to the living room.
Corinthian pink and cream yellow, grounded by orange citrine and a deep olive.
Cinnamon buff and a light mauve.

rooms.name: Dining room
rooms.about: Long table, candles, dinners that run late.

options.idea: Pompeian red with a soft salmon.
Spinel pink and Naples yellow: a pink dining room.
Brown drab, burnt sienna, one peach red and a pale turquoise.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.about: Morning light, a big table, used every day.

options.idea: Golden yellow and a warm grey.
Carmine red and pale sulphur: a red-and-cream kitchen.
Etruscan red, cinnamon buff and pistachio green.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.about: Books, a fire, a reading chair. It can be deeper than the rest.

options.idea: Cameo pink, russet and Olympic blue.
Burnt sienna and peach red against brown drab and pale turquoise.
Two pinks, pale sulphur and an olive.

rooms.name: Morning room
rooms.about: Breakfast and letters in east light. Fresh and gentle.

options.idea: Ivory, yellow orange and a soft lavender.
Spinel pink and Naples yellow for breakfast.
Corinthian pink, pale lemon and a warm grey.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.about: A smaller room for work and thinking.

options.idea: Salvia blue, neutral grey and deep indigo.
Pink and cream yellow with orange citrine and a deep olive.
Cinnamon buff and a light mauve.

rooms.name: Garden room
rooms.about: Glass on two sides, plants, the garden coming in.

options.idea: Corinthian pink and citron yellow.
Eosine pink with a citrine green.
Two pinks, pale sulphur and an olive.

rooms.name: Main bedroom
rooms.about: Quiet, soft, personal. Morning light through linen.

options.idea: Corinthian pink, pale lemon and a warm grey.
Cinnamon buff and a light mauve.
Salvia blue and grey, deep indigo in small doses.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.about: A roll-top bath under a window. Small enough to be bold.

options.idea: Old rose and white.
Carmine red and pale sulphur: bold in a small room.
Corinthian pink, pale lemon and a warm grey.
